Message:
perf_events: Generalize use of event_filter_match()

Replace all occurrences of:
	event->cpu != -1 && event->cpu == smp_processor_id()
by a call to:
	event_filter_match(event)

This makes the code more consistent and will make the cgroup
patch smaller.
